'''Rod Latham City of Brass''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]] and [[Martin Akesson]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds108.htm City of Brass], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228020701/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds108.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]] and [[Martin Akesson]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
